title: Alleviating Choice Supportive Bias in LLM with Reasoning Dependency Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in memory-based feature attribution accuracy and evaluation-based tendency scores for neutral features between model-chosen and rejected options.

Evaluating social bias amplification across 9 categories (including Age and Socioeconomic Status) using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) benchmark to ensure the primary debiasing method does not introduce or exacerbate other biases.
